Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics

Class DispersedBubbleDragSolver

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics.DispersedBubbleDragSolver
public final class DispersedBubbleDragSolver extends Object
Pure local implicit solver for Schiller-Naumann dispersed-bubble momentum exchange.

Oil and water are treated as one constrained continuous-liquid momentum during gas-liquid drag. The liquid impulse is distributed by active phase mass, so the oil-water velocity difference is unchanged. This preserves total gas-oil-water momentum and makes kinetic energy non-increasing without inventing an absent phase. Oil-water interfacial shear remains a separate closure.

    • relax

      public static double[] relax(PipeSection.FlowRegime flowRegime, double[] masses, double[] momenta, double gasDensity, double liquidDensity, double gasViscosity, double liquidViscosity, double liquidHoldup, double diameter, double surfaceTension, double timeStep, InterfacialFriction dragLaw)
      Advance gas, oil, and water momenta through one backward-Euler bubble-drag step.
      Parameters:
      flowRegime - current gas-liquid flow regime
      masses - gas, oil, and water masses per pipe length in kg/m
      momenta - gas, oil, and water momenta per pipe length in kg/s
      gasDensity - gas density in kg/m3
      liquidDensity - continuous-liquid density in kg/m3
      gasViscosity - gas viscosity in Pa s
      liquidViscosity - continuous-liquid viscosity in Pa s
      liquidHoldup - total liquid holdup
      diameter - pipe internal diameter in m
      surfaceTension - gas-liquid surface tension in N/m
      timeStep - time step in s
      dragLaw - interfacial drag closure
      Returns:
      gas, oil, and water momenta after the local drag step in kg/s
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an input is invalid
      IllegalStateException - if the closure is non-finite or the step is not dissipative
